protocol.split: per participant, chronological first floor(n/2) nights enroll/train; remaining nights split chronologically with ceil(heldout/2) validation and the rest test
protocol.preprocessing: 140 Hz -> 64 Hz; 60 s windows, 30 s stride; QC; per-window robust z; respiratory 0.08-0.7 Hz; cardiac 0.7-15 Hz
protocol.night_embedding: up to 12 evenly spaced accepted windows; median handcrafted features; StandardScaler fit on train nights only; L2 cosine retrieval
protocol.installation_interpretation: night_id is not installation_id; bed/mattress/sensor/device/installation identity unknown

qc.rejected_window_counts: not retained by the current extractor; do not infer

reproduction_of_prior_control.metric_semantics: rank estimates are participant-weighted means; query_count is the raw held-out-night count

reference_counts.bcg_estimator: median per-night spectral peak from accepted 60 s BCG windows
